main_text.p: tàm ingrata : & ad alia festino. Ha-rum ne in ulla classe[?] nomen censeri me-reatur meum, Deum cordis mei con-scium testem advoco, cui servire in spi-ritu filii sui ante omnia cupio, ea me mente ad hoc munus accedere, non ut propriæ existimationi aut affectibus, non ut alterius cujusquam voluntati aut gratiæ, sed ut unis his tribus lita-rem, Veritati, Pietati, Paci. Et quidem spero precorque eundem illum Deum, cujus gratiâ hanc misericordiam hactenus consecutus sum vilisi-mus licet peccator, ut tamen essem fi-delis: largiturum mihi in posterum, pro sua bonitate, ne ab eadem hac mente ullis aut mundi illecebris, aut machinis tentationum, aut temporum inclinationibus unquam dimovear. Cu-jus ope fretus, ut cætera non ausim polliceri

page.notes: Long s (s) rendered as plain s throughout. The word after "classe" is hard to read at the scan edge; "classe" is my best reading and is marked [?]. The italic/roman boundaries within the lines are approximate, since the scan is faint in places. The "&" with the flourish is transcribed as a plain ampersand. The printed "sciùm" with grave accent was read as "scium" (conscium, split by the line break). The last line is printed indented; it is a full line, so the paragraph continues onto the next page.
